name: Counter-Strike 2 External Organizations and Rosters, Kairos Universe 2027

referenceSnapshot.scope: Active five only; coaches, stand-ins and benched players excluded.
referenceSnapshot.note: Author-approved fictional-universe roster directive based on a historical HLTV reference snapshot. The research date is not a fictional signing date; no contract dates, transfer announcements or role assignments are established.

roleNote: The workbook does not state in-game roles. None is inferred; roster order is not a role.
disclaimer: Kairos Universe fictional continuity directive layered on a real-world reference snapshot. It is not a verified report of real-world 2027 rosters, and it establishes no results, rankings, qualification or tournament participation.

teams.name: Imperial
notes: Brazilian organization (workbook source note). Not merged with any similarly named organization.

teams.name: Team Liquid
notes: North American team (workbook source note). Reuses the existing Team Liquid organization.

teams.name: BIG
notes: A Leaguepedia-only League of Legends record named "Berlin International Gaming" exists in the frozen snapshot; it has no canonical organization identity, so it is recorded as an unverified external reference only.

teams.name: OG
notes: European organization, HLTV 10503 (workbook source note). Leaguepedia lists the unrelated League teams "O'Gaming TV" and "Original Gaming"; neither is merged.

statements: On 2027-01-29 Jake Yip receives an offer from Without a Roof to return as a professional Counter-Strike player.
He accepts the sporting proposal. He is listed on the Without a Roof roster as a former Kairos employee.
Kairos begins searching for his replacement. Tarik has been contacted as a prospective candidate only.
notEstablished: No exact departure date from Kairos is established, and no end date is recorded on his coach tenure.
Tarik is not appointed Kairos Academy head coach and has not accepted any role.
Stewie2K is not a Without a Roof player during any episode before the 2027-01-29 offer.
No contract terms, salary or buyout are established.
